name: ask_function
description: An 'Ask Function': runs an LLM prompt over every document in a RagBucket and materializes one structured row per document into a NEW table, which you can then query with plain SQL.
use_cases: Evaluate/classify/extract from each document against a natural-language condition, then query the results.
Example: 'From the resumes bucket, find candidates in IT with 5+ years of experience.'

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.example: Return industry and years_experience as JSON.

parameters.name: output_table
parameters.description: Name of the new table to create.

returns: A new table (name = output_table) with one structured row per document.
cost: expensive: one LLM call per document — confirm before running

grounding.query_hint: After it runs, SELECT from output_table like any other table.
